name: a100_lite_m128
description: The a100_lite SM at 128 SMs, the memory system scaled to 128/108 of the A100's (a100_lite's rule).

sources.inherited (a100_lite): the SM, and the rule that scales the memory system with the SMs
sources.L2_SIZE 32 MiB: the full 32 MiB from 64 SMs (the a100 profile's L2; 0.3 MiB x 128 = 38.4 MiB)
sources.PLATFORM_MEMORY_PEAK_BW 1842963, DATA_RA: 1555000 MB/s x 128 / 108; 32 HBM2 channels x 16 B x 3600 MT/s = 1843200 MB/s
